_comment: WS1.5 (Corrective Project Plan Sep 2026): the K9crush eval fixture's 12 frozen slices, expressed in the evals/evals.json convention (ACES / Agent Skills spec — see 'ACES (Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills)' in the Obsidian vault) so this suite composes with per-skill eval datasets under the same schema. `id` matches slices-manifest.json's `folder` field and results.jsonl's `slice_folder`, so a result row and its eval case can be joined directly. Derived from slices-manifest.json and AGENTS.md's 'Building a Slice' section (code/K9Crush-scaffold/K9Crush/AGENTS.md) — not invented.
_scoring_status: Schema adoption only. run-slice.sh does not yet grade expected_behavior or expected_skill against a saved trajectory — it only records passed_mechanical/iterations_to_green/agent_final_status. Wiring an ACES-style grader against these entries is a separate, not-yet-scoped follow-on, not part of WS1.5.
_expected_skill_caveat: load-slice normally runs first (AGENTS.md step 1) but is bypassed during an eval run by design: run-slice.sh hides .eventmodelers/config.json for the run's duration precisely so the agent can't reach the live board, and seeds .slices/default/ locally instead. The listed expected_skill values are the type-dispatch and status-update skills AGENTS.md names, which are exercised regardless of eval-mode.
